messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — Wave 3 of the preview enrollments kicks off next Monday (9am PST). This is the staggered cohort for merchants that asked for phased rollouts (MerchantX, LumenPay, ClearCart). Need final confirm on training slots and feedback capture flow.

Jamal Ortiz: Got it. Which time slots are still open for enablement sessions?

Priya Nair: Open slots: Mon 10am, Tue 2pm, Wed 11am (all PST). Prefer to keep MerchantX on Mon, they asked for early ramp.

Elena Park: MerchantX prefers Mon 10am. LumenPay asked for a recorded session + live Q&A — can we do Tue 2pm live and a recording posted?

Alex Wu: Yes on recording. I can run the Tue 2pm live Q&A and upload recording to the support doc afterwards.

Samir (CS Support): I'll pre-seed the invite with onboarding checklist and setup steps. Where should I link the feedback form?

Priya Nair: Use the internal preview feedback form: https://redwood.internal/surveys/preview-wave3 (short form: 6 q's). Also add an optional free-text box for integration pain points.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: add calendar invites before EOD Friday or enrollments will stay pending.

Jamal Ortiz: Noted. I'll send invites for MerchantX Mon 10am and ClearCart Wed 11am. Alex — can you handle LumenPay Tue 2pm?

Alex Wu: On it. I'll create a calendar event with Zoom + record setting ON. I'll attach the sample runbook and post-call checklist.

Priya Nair: FYI — account health flags: MerchantX has a renewal review in 45 days and reported latency concerns in last week's eval. We need a short mitigation note in the kickoff covering our latency SLOs and cache/quantization options.

Elena Park: I'll draft a 3-bullet mitigation slide: current SLO, immediate tuning we can do (prefix cache), and next-steps for Dedicated capacity if they need throughput.

Samir (CS Support): For feedback capture, recommend we include 2 quick product usage metrics at end of form: "Did generation quality meet expectations? (y/n)" and "Any blocker to go-live? (y/n)". Then auto-forward 'yes' to sync channel.

Jamal Ortiz: Good idea. Can we also tag anything that indicates renewal risk (keywords: latency, accuracy, blocker) to surface to AMs?

Priya Nair: Yes — Samir add keyword tagging. Jamal, please include AM flagging in invites so AMs see the risk.

Alex Wu: Quick logistics snippet (paste into invites):
```
Agenda (30m): 1) Quick intro 2) Integration checklist 3) Live demo 4) Q&A 5) Feedback form (2 mins)
Recording: will be uploaded to docs after session
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

Elena Park: Action items:
- Priya: confirm training slide on SLOs (owner)
- Jamal: send invites + tag AMs (owner)
- Alex: run Tue Q&A + upload recording (owner)
- Samir: attach feedback form & implement keyword tagging (owner)

Priya Nair: I'll post the finalized slide by Friday noon. Also adding a short snippet for the onboarding checklist about switching to caching mode and where to view token-level cost in Console.

Jamal Ortiz: Sent MerchantX invite (mon 10am). Tagging @Elena Park and @Priya Nair in the event.

Samir (CS Support): Feedback form pre-filled for MerchantX and ClearCart. Keyword tagging working in the form — test entry returns tag: latency.

Priya Nair: Great. One more: we should capture one integration log sample from each customer during onboarding to accelerate debugging. Add a line in invites asking for a short HAR or server-side log snippet if possible.

Alex Wu: Added log request to invite.

onboarding-bot: Scheduled reminders will send 24h and 1h before each session.

Jamal Ortiz: Thanks team — will follow up if any cancellations. Closing thread after Friday checks. :thumbsup:
